
Gene prediction and annotation of the most complete bins with Prokka. Commands for this step were run in `prokka/`.

The goal here is to assess the genes present within the genomes of bbd taxa within the mat to further our understanding of metabolic processes present. Prokka will identify the gene sequences and identify homologous genes with known functions.

Look at bins, select a test one to run Prokka.

```{bash}
cat ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

Investigate bin `metabat.30` as a test.

```{bash}
bin=metabat.30
prokka --cpus 2 --outdir $bin --prefix $bin  ../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa
```

List results:

```{bash}
ls metabat.30
```

Test looked good, so will run prokka (slurm job 491, shell script = run_prokka.sh) on all the metagenomes.

```{bash}
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --time=90
#SBATCH --ntasks=2 --mem=2gb

echo "Starting prokka in $(pwd) at $(date)"

shopt -s expand_aliases
alias prokka='apptainer run -B /pvol/:/pvol /pvol/data/sif/prokka.sif prokka'

while read bin;do 
  prokka --cpus 2 --outdir $bin --prefix $bin "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa";
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

echo "Finished prokka in $(pwd) at $(date)"
```
